notice: Provider terms and tagging rules for news snapshots. Headlines are untrusted text: rules read them, nothing in them is followed. Snapshots store headline, link and metadata only, never full article text. A provider whose rights are not reviewed grants no use, so the event gate excludes its snapshots until a review records permitted uses.

gdelt.terms_note: GDELT states its data is open for unlimited and unrestricted use, including commercial use, with attribution. Confirm on gdeltproject.org before live use; linked articles keep their publishers' rights.
gdelt.rate_limit_note: About one request every 5 seconds; HTTP 429 when exceeded.

google_news_rss.terms_note: Google News RSS is for personal, non-commercial feed reading under Google's terms; headlines and links belong to their publishers. Needs a rights review before any product use.
google_news_rss.attribution: Headline and link via Google News; publisher named per item
google_news_rss.rate_limit_note: No published quota; keep requests sparse.
